units: Sabb. IV, 1) putting a dish in a warm place or under covers to keep it warm for the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Shabbat 39b:1">Ib. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>בטלה ה׳ וכ׳</he> the permission to keep a dish in matter which adds heat was abolished.
<cite ref="Shabbat 50a:2">Ib. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>יחדן לה׳</he> he designated them to be used for keeping dishes warm; a. fr.
